items.answer: Named export isInvestmentGrade(rating) in src/ratings/notch.mjs; one argument; returns boolean true when the normalised rating's index in RATING_SCALE is 0–9, false for 10–18. Normalisation is notchChange's own (reuse the module's private indexOf helper).
items.quote: The rating is read exactly as `notchChange` reads it (trimmed, case-insensitive)

items.answer: Anything that does not normalise to a RATING_SCALE entry throws the same RangeError notchChange throws (message `unknown rating: ${JSON.stringify(rating)}`); never returns false as a fallback.
items.quote: anything else is rejected with the same RangeError

items.answer: Node.js 18+, plain ES modules (.mjs), no npm dependencies; node:test + node:assert/strict, run with `node --test`.
Only input validation applies: pure function, no auth, secrets, I/O or logging; input checked against the closed RATING_SCALE, else RangeError. Checked by tests on invalid inputs.
